metadata.title: MurderBall Canonical Data & Provenance Manifest
metadata.governance: AQX Sports Analytics Data Bowl 4.0 Independent Review Standard

count_discrepancy_resolutions.header_181_matches_explanation: The 181 figure in legacy headers was computed as 120 Paralympic matches + 37 Invitational matches + 24 WC 2026 group stage matches. The canonical count is 166 official international championship matches (120 Paralympic + 46 World Championship 2026) or 203 total matches when including the 37 invitational matches.
count_discrepancy_resolutions.athletes_329_vs_204_explanation: 329 is the comprehensive count of registered international athletes in the IPC Master Registry (ipc_athlete_master_registry.json). 204 is the subset of unique athlete profiles appearing in Paralympic match box scores across Athens 2004 to Paris 2024.
count_discrepancy_resolutions.stints_5148_vs_5123_explanation: 5,148 is the verified total continuous stint intervals in all_stints.json. The 5,123 count previously seen was caused by match PAR24_M20 in all_paralympic_matches.json holding an older 13-stint extract instead of its full 38 stints. PAR24_M20 has now been canonically synchronized, establishing 5,148 stints across both datasets.

epistemic_trust_tiers.VERIFIED_OBSERVATION: Directly extracted from and reconciled against official IPC results books or JWRF/WWR official publications.
epistemic_trust_tiers.REPRODUCED_ANALYSIS: Derived mathematically and statistically from verified observations using fully executable, deterministic code.
epistemic_trust_tiers.VALIDATED_PREDICTION: Predictive model forecast strictly evaluated against out-of-time, un-leaked historical competition outcomes.
epistemic_trust_tiers.MODEL_DERIVED_ESTIMATE: Statistical output dependent on explicit model assumptions (e.g., win probability models, Elo updates).
epistemic_trust_tiers.EXPLORATORY_RESULT: Statistical association that reveals interesting patterns but lacks definitive causal confirmation or exhibits confounding.
epistemic_trust_tiers.HYPOTHETICAL_SCENARIO: Counterfactual tactical simulation or hypothetical decision that did not occur in recorded history.
epistemic_trust_tiers.UNSUPPORTED_OR_WITHDRAWN: Claims lacking empirical measurement in official records (e.g., 'uncontested tries' without tracking data).
